name: Device row screen swap
looks: A row of identical device mockups lines up across the frame, each showing a different screen of the same product. The devices stay fixed while the camera drifts slowly past; the screen content inside each frame slides or wipes to the next feature, each on its own offset timing, reading as a continuous tour through several capabilities.
build: Fixed device frame positions, evenly spaced; inside each frame's mask the old screen pushes out as the new one slides or wipes in (yPercent -100 to 0, expo.out, 0.35-0.45 s), staggered so no two devices change at the same instant; never an opacity fade. A slow camera dolly (translateX 15-20 px/s) supplies motion though the devices don't move relative to each other.
sound: A soft whoosh under the camera drift, a light tick on each screen swap.
prompt: Line up several identical device mockups across the frame, each running a different screen of the same product, and drift the camera past while each screen slides to a new feature on its own offset beat, so one slow move tours several capabilities at once.
source: prompt-motion.com's gallery (jesscaroline7-1ff7cb), studied 2026-10-09; the source's cross-fade swaps restaged as slides
